claims.claim: The Spectrum is the building where Dr. J and Moses won the 1983 title

sources.title: On This Date | Philadelphia Wins Second Title

claims.evidence: The 76ers swept the Lakers 4-0 and clinched with a 115-108 Game 4 win on May 31, 1983, at the Forum in Los Angeles. Moses Malone was Finals MVP. The Spectrum was their home building, not where the title was won.
